gaps.item: Contest mode in the practice-session runner (answer clock, Ranked chip, Skip, Rules link, Full screen, leave sheet, flag triggers + banner, Confirm step, race rail, field line in the verdict, result-panel summary)
gaps.source: spec/rebuild-v2.md 3.7 §8 'The runner in contest mode'; compete.md C15 (triggers, Confirm step), C8 (race rail), C6 (field line), C17, C24 (Rules link); §3.1 entry 27
gaps.evidence: Playwright, new learner, /compete/contest/?id=daily → Start: /practice/session/ header reads 'Exit | Daily challenge | 0:03 elapsed' (a stopwatch counting up, not the 15:50 answer clock). No Ranked chip, no Skip button, no Rules link, no Full screen. With the tab hidden 6 s there was no POST /void and no banner. session.js/runner.js contain no /void, /confirm, hasFocus, pacer or 'Leave the challenge' code, and the session page doesn't load compete-ui.js. GET /api/drill/{sid} already returns contest, ranked and clock, and the answer returns field {source:'contest', share, n}, but none of it is drawn. The summary is the practice summary with a 'Board' pill to /compete/, not the §4 result panel.
gaps.build: In web/assets/runner.js and practice/session, when state.contest is set: show a Ranked/Unranked chip; draw a countdown from state.clock.left/running (dimmed on a verdict); add a quiet Skip (POST next {skip:true}); add a Rules sheet (the §1.2 list) and optional Full screen. Post /api/drill/{sid}/void for tab hidden ≥5 s, window blur ≥5 s (calculator host exempt), copy-then-leave within 20 s, a paste outside the calculator, and a pagehide beacon, and show the first-flag banner. After the last answer run the Confirm step (POST /confirm until due is empty; the server must expose confirm {due,next} in GET state). Render UI.pacer when a race is set, and the field line in the verdict. On finish, go to the contest page's result panel.

gaps.item: Exit/X in a contest sitting hands the Daily in
gaps.source: spec 3.7 §1.2 'Leaving', §8 'X no longer hands the sitting in', acceptance 27
gaps.evidence: Playwright a:cxaudrun1: started today's Daily, clicked Exit on Q1 without answering. The page went to /practice/ with no sheet, and GET /api/drill/{sid} → finished 2026-09-28T20:25:13, answered 0. /api/contest/daily → me.status 'finished', ranked True, points 0, so the one ranked sitting is gone. After one answer, Exit opens the generic 'Leave this set? … The clock keeps running while you are away.' with End and see summary / Keep it for later.
gaps.build: For contest sittings, X opens 'Leave the challenge? This question will be skipped. The clock stops until you come back. Finish before 11:59 PM.' with Leave (skip the open question and return to the contest page, which shows Resume), Hand in now, and × Stay. On a verdict it reads 'Come back before 11:59 PM to finish.' Never quiet-finish a contest sitting.

gaps.item: Rush runs can't be played
gaps.source: compete.md C13 (Rush), acceptance 1-5
gaps.evidence: Playwright a:cxaudrush1 on /compete/contest/?id=rush-2026-W40 → Start → /practice/session/?id=honx1… shows 'That set does not exist.', and GET /api/drill/{sid} returns 404. rush_start returns runner 'session', but Rush sittings are served only through /api/contest/{cid}/next|answer|finish, which the session page never calls. Overview also shows a started run as 'In progress · 0:00 left'.
gaps.build: Either give Rush its own runner mode (Sprint mode header 'Right 14 · strikes ✕✕○ · now L6', key and mistake line, 'Why' collapsed) that calls /api/contest/{cid}/next, answer and finish, or make Rush sessions answerable through /api/drill/{sid}. Drop the clock text from Rush rows.

gaps.item: First-time Sprint start and 'Race your best' links fail
gaps.source: compete.md C8 (pacers: Sprint and Rush default to your best), C9 empty state 'Race your best'
gaps.evidence: The Sprint lobby preselects Race: 'Your best', so a new player's Start sends POST /api/contest/sprint-2026-W40/start?race=best, which returns 404 {'detail':'no previous run to race'} (a:cxaudspr1, seen in Playwright). The same 404 affects daily?race=best. The Overview Rivals empty state (new learners) links 'Race your best' to /compete/contest/?id=daily&race=best, which renders 'There's no contest with that link.'
gaps.build: When race=best and there is no previous run, start or return the contest with no pacer (race null) instead of 404. On the page, default the select to 'Your best' only when the learner has a run, and hide 'Race your best' when they don't.

gaps.item: The answer clock doesn't end the sitting at 0
gaps.source: spec 3.7 §1.2 'When the clock hits 0, the open question scores 0 and the sitting ends'; §3.7.5 drill.overtime uses compete.clock
gaps.evidence: API sprint run (a:cxaudp09), answers sent with ms=100000: clock.left reached 0 after 3 answers, but /next kept serving and finished stayed null through 8 answers. On finish: points 120, secs 800 against a 300 s clock, all 8 right scored. The seeded Sprint recorded secs 480 on a 300 s clock.
gaps.build: In the drill next/answer path for contest sittings: when compete.clock(row).left hits 0, refuse the next question, score the open one 0 and finish the sitting. Cap secs at the contest's seconds (× the timing factor).

gaps.item: Server-measured answer time (attempts.sms)
gaps.source: spec 3.7.5 drill.py '_serve sets q[served]; answer() computes sms = min(now − served, clock left)'; §3.7.2 'Board time: worse'; C15 'fast' trigger
gaps.evidence: drill.py:2568 reads '# ponytail: attempts.sms stays Compete's (S8 scores the client's ms today…)' and sets sms = None. Every contest attempt row in the DB has sms NULL. compete.clock sums COALESCE(sms, ms), so the clock, the board's Time column, too-fast detection and pace-setter (which reads sms ≤ 95000) all depend on the client's ms. Review field median_ms is None and the Grid footer median_ms is None.
gaps.build: On a contest answer, compute sms = min(now − q.served, clock left) and pass it to progress.record(sms=). Use sms for clock.used, board secs, the fast flag, the pace bonus, field median_ms in review and grid, and the badges.

gaps.item: Word Sprint (Reading & Writing in Compete) and the Subject select
gaps.source: compete.md C14 (Word Sprint), acceptance 1; §3.1 entry 19 (Subject select)
gaps.evidence: GET /api/contests?status=live has no kind 'words' row. words.sprint_available() is false because the transition pools are empty: 0 of 153 transition pairs are reviewed. With SATF_WORDS_UNREVIEWED=1 the pools hold 302/247/56. So compete.ensure never inserts words-2026-W40, and the Leaderboard has no Subject select (leaderboard.js: 'Subject waits until a second subject has a board').
gaps.build: Review (or ship) enough W2 Transitions pairs at each tier so sprint_available() is true. Then the weekly words-YYYY-Www contest is scheduled. Show the Leaderboard Subject select (Math · Reading & Writing) once it exists.

gaps.item: Past days of the Daily (ghost sittings, make-up, date picker)
gaps.source: spec 3.7 §4 header (day navigation, date input min = first stored day), 'Closed / past day, not sat'; §3.7.4 'Any past day can be regenerated'; compete.md C25 make-up
gaps.evidence: GET /api/contest/daily-2026-09-27, -09-25 and -09-01 all return 404 'contest not found'. Playwright seeded learner on daily-2026-09-28, clicking '‹ Sep 27': 'There's no contest with that link.' The date input has no min attribute (min ''), so any picked day can 404. POST start on a past day returns 404 too, so no ghost sitting or make-up is possible for a day nobody opened.
gaps.build: compete.contest('daily-YYYY-MM-DD') lazily creates any past day up to today (the canonical slots from the date, as ensure does for today), so the page, ghost sittings and make-ups work. Set the date input min to the first stored or supported day.

gaps.item: Rating change per sitting (rating_before/after) is lost
